title: Tranquility Spa Concierge
description: Turned a crowded spa menu into a guided booking flow that gives staff the context behind each appointment.
seoDescription: A working spa concierge that guides the customer's choice and passes the result into the staff workflow.
constraints: Recommendations had to come from an approved service catalog and exact duration matches rather than generic AI knowledge.
A non-technical business needed to update services and operate visits without rebuilding the concierge.
The recommended service had to remain attached to the appointment through the entire visit.
problem: A crowded spa menu left visitors choosing by unfamiliar service names. When someone booked, staff received no record of the guidance that led there.
solution: Built a concierge that filters 20 services to an eligible treatment, then attaches that choice to the Airtable appointment staff use for the visit.
result: The working prototype carried the recommended service from the guest conversation into the staff visit record.
Twenty services remained manageable through one editable catalog and six shared booking groups.
Typebot's 200-chat free tier became the remaining production constraint; another conversation tool could use the same workflow.
deliveryHighlights: A spa website where owners can try the concierge in context.
A staff workspace in Airtable that Make updates after each guest action.
A tested path from DeepSeek recommendation to Cal.com booking and Tally intake.
